g.text: VM = PSU positive; keep VM / VBUS at 0-36V. 3V3 comes from the host. IN+/IN- insert the module shunt in each B lead. PWM/flyback input limits remain to be validated.

g.desc: VM = PSU positive; keep VM / VBUS at 0-36V. 3V3 comes from the host. IN+/IN- insert the module shunt in each B lead. PWM/flyback input limits remain to be validated.

g.text: IN+ from coil B; IN- to driver B. Shunt is ON MODULE.

g.desc: IN+ from coil B; IN- to driver B. Shunt is ON MODULE.

g.text: IN+ from coil B; IN- to driver B. Shunt is ON MODULE.

g.desc: IN+ from coil B; IN- to driver B. Shunt is ON MODULE.

g.text: M1 = X; M2 = Y. Coil A/B are switching outputs.

g.desc: M1 = X; M2 = Y. Coil A/B are switching outputs.

g.text: IN+ from coil B; IN- to driver B. Shunt is ON MODULE.

g.desc: IN+ from coil B; IN- to driver B. Shunt is ON MODULE.

g.text: INA MODULE ADDRESS PADS (power off before soldering)

g.desc: INA MODULE ADDRESS PADS (power off before soldering)

g.text: X: A0 to VCC -> 0x41; Y: A1 to VCC -> 0x44; Z: A0 and A1 to VCC -> 0x45.

g.desc: X: A0 to VCC -> 0x41; Y: A1 to VCC -> 0x44; Z: A0 and A1 to VCC -> 0x45.

g.text: Unbridged address pins must default to GND on the purchased modules. Verify settings with an I2C scan.

g.desc: Unbridged address pins must default to GND on the purchased modules. Verify settings with an I2C scan.

g.text: COIL CURRENT PATH: driver OUTA -> coil A -> coil B -> INA IN+ -> ON-MODULE SHUNT -> INA IN- -> driver OUTB.

g.desc: COIL CURRENT PATH: driver OUTA -> coil A -> coil B -> INA IN+ -> ON-MODULE SHUNT -> INA IN- -> driver OUTB.

g.text: J15/J16/J17 probe the actual coil A/B terminals, after the shunts.

g.desc: J15/J16/J17 probe the actual coil A/B terminals, after the shunts.

g.text: PWM/flyback compatibility is not validated; INA226 inputs must remain within their specified limits.

g.desc: PWM/flyback compatibility is not validated; INA226 inputs must remain within their specified limits.

g.text: MODULE FOOTPRINT PIN OFFSETS ARE PROVISIONAL: verify actual parts before fabrication. PCB placement and routing: Padam.

g.desc: MODULE FOOTPRINT PIN OFFSETS ARE PROVISIONAL: verify actual parts before fabrication. PCB placement and routing: Padam.

g.text: M1 = Z; M2 = SPARE. Coil A/B are switching outputs.

g.desc: M1 = Z; M2 = SPARE. Coil A/B are switching outputs.
